name: Hooks
why: A guard hook, from the rule it backs to the call it checks
ideal: Each guard is said where a thread reads it, backed by a safe hook that adds little time or text.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

steps.name: Say
steps.rule: Each guard is said in a file a cloud thread reads.

steps.name: Safe
steps.rule: No hook force pushes, skips a check, deletes recursively or pipes a download to a shell.

steps.name: Run
steps.rule: A hook adds under a second to a call.

steps.name: Text
steps.rule: Hooks inject little text at start.
